title: Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite Index closes above 8000; up 59.48 points at 8,013.71
text:
Shutterstock photo Thursday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index up above 8000 points. The index first reached the 8000 mark on Aug 27, 2018. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.25 billion.
Advancers stocks led declining by 1.09 to 1 ratio. There were 1605 advancers and 1469 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 77 stocks reached a 52 week high and 39 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed up .98% for the day; a total of 73.63 points. The current value is 7,561.69. Seagate Technology PLC ( STX ) had the largest percent change down (-2.55%) while NetEase, Inc. ( NTES ) had the largest percent change gain rising 5.31%.
The Dow Jones index closed up .57% for the day; a total of 147.07 points. The current value is 26,145.99. McDonald's Corporation ( MCD ) had the largest percent change down (-1.42%) while Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change gain rising 2.42%.
